title: Comm stream prioritization and cross-node chunking to improve TP overlap and reduce tail latency
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: tensor-parallel (TP) workloads on multi-node setups exhibit long tail latencies due to monolithic NCCL collectives and contention on default streams, especially during KV-cache population and model weight syncs. This PR implements two coordinated runtime changes to improve overlap and reduce tail: 1) prioritized communication streams where small latency-sensitive collectives (KV cache updates, prefix gathers) are dispatched on high-priority NCCL/ CUDA streams while bulk syncs use lower-priority lanes; 2) cross-node chunking for large allgather/allreduce operations which slices large tensors into smaller, configurable chunks and pipelined-chunks across nodes to increase compute/comm overlap. The implementation includes a scheduler heuristic that marks collectives as latency-sensitive vs throughput-sensitive based on tensor size and kv-cache flags, a new config layer with knobs tp_comm_chunk_size, nccl_stream_priority_map, and cross_node_chunk_threshold, and NCCL launch-tuning to reduce GPU stalls by pre-allocating comm events and queueing comms on dedicated CUDA streams. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve current behavior (chunking disabled when chunk size=0 and priority map uses default stream). Checklist: Implement prioritized streams and priority map in runtime; Add chunking logic in tp/collectives module; Expose config knobs and runtime metrics (comm_stream, chunk_id); Add unit tests for stream assignment; Add perf harness scenarios and regression benchmarks; Update docs and runtime config schema. Testing: unit tests and CI integration passed, perf harness run on 2x4xA100(80GB) nodes with synthetic and real prefix workloads. Results and microbenchmarks are summarized in metrics section below. Rollout: gated feature flagged under runtime.experimental.tp_comm_prioritization and enabled for internal perf lab only. This PR is focused on runtime orchestration and scheduling; kernel-level changes limited to conditional kernel launch ordering. See commits and changed_files below for details.

review_comments: Marco Liu: Nice direction. Please add a safety net for chunk reassembly failures so we can detect partial reorders across nodes. Also add metrics for number of chunks and chunk latency.

Priya Desai (author): Added chunk-failure detection and a reassembly timeout metric. Reassembly now emits chunk_count and chunk_reassembly_latency metrics to runtime.metrics. See runtime/collectives/tp_collectives.cpp commit c9e7f15.

Ava Thompson: The priority map needs a deterministic fallback in mixed GPU priority environments (NVIDIA drivers behave differently across OS). Please add a fallback to default stream when priority APIs fail.
Priya Desai: Added try-catch around stream priority assignment and fallback to default stream with a runtime warning metric. Documented behavior in docs/runtime/comm-prioritization.md.
Diego Ramos: Perf harness shows a perf regression in small-batch throughput for cross_node_chunk_threshold=1MB. Could we refine the heuristic to disable cross-node chunking for small bbatches?

Priya Desai: Heuristic updated to use per-request tensor count and size; default threshold increased to 8MB. Added config cross_node_chunk_threshold and runtime decision logic. Perf run updated and included in metrics.
ci_checks: perf-harness: initial-fail (chunk-reassembly corner case) -> re-run -> pass
release_notes: Improves TP multi-GPU tail latency by introducing prioritized comm streams and optional cross-node chunking. Config knobs added: tp_comm_chunk_size, nccl_stream_priority_map, cross_node_chunk_threshold. Feature gated behind runtime.experimental.tp_comm_prioritization.
metrics: Lab perf (2 nodes, 4 GPUs each, A100 80GB) on realistic prefix workloads: 99th-token latency -18% (580ms -> 475ms), p50 latency -6% (120ms -> 113ms), overall throughput +9% for mixed-length batches. KV-cache heavy scenario: tail reduction benefits more pronounced: 99th -26%. Overhead: in small-batch microbenchmarks with chunking enabled and threshold too low we initially saw -4% throughput which was mitigated by raising default threshold to 8MB.
test_plan: Unit tests added for stream assignment and chunking edge cases. Perf harness scenarios added and executed in CI perf lane. Manual e2e validation on internal perf lab across 2-node cluster with both synthetic and production-like traces. Canary rollout behind feature flag for internal customers followed by staged rollout.
notes: This PR focuses on scheduler/collective orchestration rather than kernel fusion; future work tracked under ENG-10311 will explore kernel-level interleaving with chunked comms.
